title: Intergenerational Learning Seminar II
description: Facilitates the continuation of relationships formed in Term 1 and INDW 526 with fellow students, faculty, and the community. Championing a community-led and intergenerational mentorship approach, complexities and strengths related to Indigenous nurse-led research and knowledge gathering for practice will be discussed. Includes a land-based immersion experience, fostering a deeper understanding of the interconnectedness of Indigenous Knowledges and Indigenous research methodologies.
notes: Credit will be granted for only one of INDW 527, INDW 527A, INDW 527B
